text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon continues to achieve solid 
results in her races. With her rising 
popularity, larger crowds gather for her 
street live performances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, she made a shocking request: she 
wanted her next goal to be the Satsuki 
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Turf was not her strong suit. On top of 
that, the Classic Triple Crown was packed 
with the absolute best Umamusume of their 
generation. Securing a victory would be 
exceedingly difficult.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she decided to take on the 
Satsuki Sho. All so she could sing a song 
that could only be performed on the stage 
of the Classic Triple Crown for her fans—!
